title: Belle Vernon Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Belle Vernon is a 4 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Located within walking distance of downtown Seaside and right next to the beloved Ruskin Park, Belle Vernon is the quiet get-away that you and your family can enjoy any time of the year.
description_expanded: Description160 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 3 QUEENS, 1 TWIN - Sleeps 9Belle Vernon | Classic Seaside Cottage Near Beach & Town CenterWelcome to Belle Vernon, a beautifully updated beach cottage nestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Ideally located just a four-minute walk to the beach, Seaside Avenue, the town center, the West Side Pool, and the art-filled paths of Ruskin Park, this home offers an exceptional blend of walkability, comfort, and timeless coastal charm. With a private driveway, four inviting porches, and a spacious open-air sun deck, Belle Vernon is designed for relaxed living and memorable gatherings.Inviting Porches & Outdoor LivingFramed by a classic white picket fence, the front screened porch welcomes you with traditional rocking chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Out back, a fenced backyard oasis features a large wooden deck, outdoor dining for four, and a gas grill, perfect for casual al fresco dinners under the stars.Upstairs, the open-air sun deck is a standout feature, furnished with Adirondack chairs and chaise loungers and offering peaceful views of East Ruskin Street and the surrounding treetops—an ideal place to unwind at sunset.Bright, Open Living SpacesStep inside to a light-filled living area designed for connection and comfort. Two oversized sofas, a pair of club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV create a welcoming space for movie nights or family game time. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a four-burner gas range, ample cookware, and a breakfast bar for two. Adjacent, the dining area comfortably seats six, making it easy to gather after a day at the beach.Thoughtful Bedroom Layout for Groups & FamiliesBelle Vernon offers four bedrooms plus a bonus twin room, comfortably accommodating up to nine guests across two well-planned levels.On the first floor, the front queen bedroom includes an ensuite bath with a tub/shower combo, dresser, and generous closet space. A second queen bedroom at the rear also features an ensuite bath, flat-screen TV, closet, and its own private screened porch overlooking the fenced backyard.Second-Floor Retreats & Flexible SpacesUpstairs, a central landing provides a cozy sitting area and a dedicated desk, ideal for remote work or quiet reading. The king bedroom includes a reading nook, mounted bedside lights, and access to a shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a private vanity. This bath connects to a queen bedroom featuring a flat-screen TV, dresser, and access to another private screened porch with a bench swing and treetop views.An additional bonus twin room with a dresser adds flexible sleeping space, perfect for children or extra guests.Your Ideal Seaside, Florida GetawayWhether you’re gathering with family, reconnecting with friends, or simply craving a laid-back beach escape, Belle Vernon offers a warm and welcoming retreat in one of Seaside’s most desirable locations. With walkable access to the beach and town center, multiple outdoor living spaces, and room for everyone to relax, this cottage is the perfect setting for unforgettable Seaside, Florida memories.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURES1,910 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceLocated just 352 yards (approximately a 4-minute walk) to East Ruskin Pavilion beach access, part of the largest private residential beaches on Scenic Highway 30ALarge open-air sun deck, ideal for relaxing and soaking in the Seaside atmospherePrivate driveway for convenient off-street parkingGas grill located on the rear deck for easy outdoor diningKeurig K-Duo coffee system, offering carafe coffee, single-serve cups, and iced coffee optionsFull-size washer and dryer for guest conveniencePeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towelsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (golf carts are considered vehicles)Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances or medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002044
